carrier_theorem.setup: Fix the microscopic Q3 regulator N and a symmetric compact source interval I=[-h_0,h_0]. For each finite periodic Lambda and h in I use the exact Hamiltonian H_(Lambda,N)(h), its physical real-time group alpha_t^(Lambda,h)=Ad exp[it H_(Lambda,N)(h)/hbar], and finite-support rational configuration characters W_(Lambda,xi).
carrier_theorem.generators: For xi in the countable rational label set and f in L1(R), let pi_(Lambda,h)(A_(xi,f))=integral f(t) alpha_t^(Lambda,h)(W_(Lambda,xi)) dt. Start from the unital formal star algebra, impose linearity in f and A_(xi,f)^*=A_(-xi,bar f), take the supremum norm over every finite periodic Lambda and h in I, quotient its common null ideal and complete.
carrier_theorem.common_action: Kernel translation (tau_s f)(t)=f(t-s) induces theta_s A_(xi,f)=A_(xi,tau_s f). Equivariance and L1 translation continuity make theta one source-, sign-, state- and beta-independent point-norm C0 automorphism group on the completed categorical carrier A_(N,I). The physical KMS strip is 0<=Im z<=beta hbar.
carrier_theorem.parity: Exact Q3 parity intertwines H_(Lambda,N)(h) with H_(Lambda,N)(-h). Symmetry of I therefore induces the isometric involution gamma A_(xi,f)=A_(-xi,f), commuting with theta.
carrier_theorem.selected_kms_pair: At fixed physical inverse temperature beta in the registered Q3 corridor, pull back the paired finite Gibbs tangent nets (Lambda_n,+h_n) and (Lambda_n,-h_n), h_n->0. They are physical-beta Gibbs/KMS states, equivalently mathematical (beta hbar)-KMS states for theta. Joint weak-star cluster pairs exist; KMS weak-star closure at the fixed mathematical parameter beta hbar gives the same property to both limits, and parity gives omega_-=omega_+ o gamma.
carrier_theorem.categorical_boundary: The theorem is exact on the source-family orbit-smear completion. It proves no spatial quasi-local net, all-exhaustion Hamiltonian thermodynamic limit, zero-source quotient factorization, canonical raw oscillator or momentum algebra, polynomial local generator, algebraic ground state, GNS gap, purity or exhaustive phase classification.

zero_source_quotient.factorization_criterion: A state omega on A_(N,I) factors through q_0 if and only if omega(k^*k)=0 for every k in ker q_0, equivalently omega vanishes on ker q_0.
